diagnosis: All four rollouts followed an identical, clean disclosure pattern: A1 opened, A2–A5 each revealed PF1–PF4 respectively, and A1 settled at turn 5. Every fact was revealed and cited in justification_fact_ids in every rollout, so the failures are purely ENCODING MISMATCH — the checks' expected strings do not match how models naturally phrase the same correct information. The gate failed (1/4 pass, needed 3) because checks C7, C8, C9, C10, and C6 are too narrowly worded. C7 (linked to PF1) passed only in rollout 2 where power_mode was the terse "reduced HVAC"; it failed in rollouts 0, 1, and 3 where the model wrote longer but semantically identical variants like "reduced HVAC while projection and amplification remain on" or "HVAC on reduced setting while projection and amplification remain on". C8 (linked to PF2) failed in rollout 0 despite the decision field containing "reduced HVAC while projection and amplification remain on" — the same wording that passed C8 in rollouts 1 and 3. C9 (linked to PF3) failed in rollouts 0 and 3 despite mobility_access_route being exactly "east-entry-with-ramp" in all four rollouts. C10 (linked to PF4) failed in rollouts 0 and 3 despite effects_mode containing "lighting and projected flame imagery" with "no open flame" language. C6 (linked to PF4) failed in rollout 3 with effects_mode "lighting-and-projected-imagery (no open flame, no cold spark)" but passed in rollouts 0, 1, and 2 with similar phrasings. No rollout hit the turn cap; no telepathy or disclosure failures occurred.

C9.why: The access walkthrough changes the mobility route from the draft west doors to the east entrance with ramp and requires that route to be documented.

C10.why: The insurance endorsement changes the effects from open flame to lighting and projected flame imagery and requires the compliant substitution to be recorded.

C7.why: The inspection changes the audience number from the draft 500 to exactly 420, changes balcony access from open to closed, and requires the matching written restriction.

C6.why: The insurance endorsement changes the effects from open flame to lighting and projected flame imagery and requires the compliant substitution to be recorded.

fix_instructions: All failures are ENCODING MISMATCH — the checks must be broadened to accept semantically equivalent phrasings. (1) C7 (PF1, balcony written restriction): the check apparently keys on an exact power_mode string like "reduced HVAC" and rejects longer qualifiers; broaden it to accept any power_mode containing both "reduced" and "HVAC" regardless of trailing clauses about projection/amplification. (2) C8 (PF2, power condition cited and logged): the check is inconsistent — it passes "reduced HVAC with projection and amplification on" (rollout 3) and "HVAC on reduced setting while projection and amplification remain on" (rollout 1) but fails the nearly identical "reduced HVAC while projection and amplification remain on" (rollout 0); align the matcher to accept any power_mode containing "reduced" and "HVAC" plus either "projection" or "amplification". (3) C9 (PF3, mobility route documented): the check fails even when mobility_access_route is exactly "east-entry-with-ramp" (rollouts 0 and 3) yet passes the identical value in rollouts 1 and 2; this indicates the check is also testing a secondary field or commitment wording — inspect whether C9 additionally requires a specific commitment type or detail phrasing and broaden that condition to accept any commitment whose detail references "east" and "ramp". (4) C10 (PF4, compliant substitution recorded): the check fails "lighting and projected flame imagery, no actual open flame" (rollout 0) and "lighting-and-projected-imagery (no open flame, no cold spark)" (rollout 3) but passes "cold-spark-free presentation using lighting and projected flame imagery" (rollout 2) and "lighting and projected flame imagery (no open flame)" (rollout 1); broaden C10 to accept any effects_mode containing both "lighting" and "projected" and "flame" (or "imagery") with no requirement for the literal phrase "cold-spark-free". (5) C6 (PF4, effects mode): the check fails "lighting-and-projected-imagery (no open flame, no cold spark)" (rollout 3) but passes similar phrasings in other rollouts; broaden C6 to accept any effects_mode that contains "lighting" and "projected" and explicitly excludes open flame, regardless of whether the hyphenated or spaced variant is used. No changes to shared_context, agent personalities, or scenario structure are needed — disclosure and settlement are working correctly.
